commit.message:
Add ninja and sccache in a buildfarm-only environment (#1854)

* Point the Qt plugin path at the environment in use

QT_QPA_PLATFORM_PLUGIN_PATH was spelled out as .pixi/envs/default, which
is only correct for the default environment.  Any other environment gets
a path into a directory that holds a different set of packages, or none
at all, and qt_gui_cpp then fails to find a platform plugin at runtime
with no obvious connection to the cause.

%CONDA_PREFIX% is the environment pixi actually activated, so it is right
in every environment including the default one.  Note the percent form:
pixi does not expand $CONDA_PREFIX here, it passes it through literally.

Signed-off-by: Michael Carroll <mjcarroll.oss@gmail.com>

* Add ninja and sccache in a buildfarm-only environment

The ROS 2 buildfarm is moving its Windows jobs onto the Ninja generator
with sccache as a compiler launcher, and it gets its tooling from this
file.  Neither tool is needed to build ROS 2, though, and [dependencies]
is installed for everyone who uses this manifest -- so putting them there
would hand every ROS 2 developer a compiler cache and a build tool they
did not ask for, and pay for them on every pixi install.

A feature and an environment scope them instead.  An environment is the
default feature plus the features it names, so "buildfarm" is everything
in [dependencies] and these two on top; the buildfarm asks for it by name
with 'pixi install -e buildfarm' and 'pixi run -e buildfarm', and the
default environment is unchanged.  Anyone who does want them locally can
use the same environment rather than installing them by hand and hoping
the versions line up.

Ninja is not optional for the cache, which is why both arrive together:
CMake honours CMAKE_<LANG>_COMPILER_LAUNCHER only under the Ninja and
Makefile generators, and silently ignores it under Visual Studio.

Both are pinned loosely, as tooling whose APIs we do not depend on.
Ubuntu 26.04 ships sccache 0.13.0, but this is not held to the Ubuntu
versions the way the library dependencies are.

Signed-off-by: Michael Carroll <mjcarroll.oss@gmail.com>

* Update pixi.lock for the buildfarm environment

Signed-off-by: Michael Carroll <mjcarroll.oss@gmail.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: Michael Carroll <mjcarroll.oss@gmail.com>
